title: Fourier coefficients of the mod-three function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $S$ be a set of coordinates in the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The function that is $1$ when the sum of the input signs is divisible by $3$ and $0$ otherwise has Fourier coefficient at $S$ equal to $\mathbf{1}_{S=\varnothing}/3$ plus, when $|S|$ is even, $\frac{2}{3}(-\frac12)^n(-1)^{(|S|\bmod 4)/2}(\sqrt{3})^{|S|}$, and otherwise equal to just $\mathbf{1}_{S=\varnothing}/3$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
